Message.Name: Enter Order
Message.Description: Enters a new order into the system. The response to a successful Enter Order is an Order Accepted message. If the order is rejected, the Order Rejected message will be returned.

Field.Name: Order Token
Field.Description: Client-generated order identifier

Field.Name: Order Book Id
Field.Description: Order book identifier

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Order side

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Order quantity. Must be a multiple of the Round Lot Size for the order book

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Signed integer price. Number of decimals and allowed tick steps are given by the Order book Directory message in ITCH

Field.Name: Time In Force
Field.Description: Time in force

Field.Name: Open Close
Field.Description: Position update for the account

Field.Name: Client Account
Field.Description: Pass-thru field. Mandatory for Fund orders (Agency/Fund Code). Account Info should use this field for the derivatives market

Field.Name: Customer Info
Field.Description: Pass-thru client reference field. Non-printable ASCII characters should not exist in this field

Field.Name: Exchange Info
Field.Description: Client account number. Only the first 16 bytes are used. Account Info should use this field for the equity market

Field.Name: Display Quantity
Field.Description: Display quantity if reserved order, otherwise set to zero (0)

Field.Name: Client Category
Field.Description: Type of client. Not used by the derivatives market

Field.Name: Off Hours
Field.Description: Off-hours indicator. Used by the derivatives market

Field.Name: SMP Level
Field.Description: Indicates the scope of self-match prevention

Field.Name: SMP Method
Field.Description: Indicates the action that should be undertaken by the trading system in case of a potential self-match

Field.Name: SMP Id
Field.Description: Defines that the order is eligible for self-match prevention. For SMP Level 1, assigned by member; for SMP Level 2, assigned by the exchange

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Message.Name: Replace Order
Message.Description: Modifies an existing order entered via OUCH. The response is an Order Replaced message if the modification was successful, or an Order Rejected message if the replace failed.

Field.Name: Existing Order Token
Field.Description: Should be the Order Token from the original Enter Order, not from any intermediate replaces

Field.Name: Replacement Order Token
Field.Description: Client-generated replacement order identifier. Must not be a token previously used in Enter Order or Replace Order transactions

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Desired open quantity of the order relative to the original order quantity

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Replacement price. Setting price to 0 means no change

Field.Name: Replace Open Close
Field.Description: Position update for the account

Field.Name: Client Account
Field.Description: Pass-thru field. Account Info should use this field for the derivatives market

Field.Name: Customer Info
Field.Description: Pass-thru field. Non-printable ASCII characters should not exist in this field

Field.Name: Exchange Info
Field.Description: Client account number. Only the first 16 bytes are used. Account Info should use this field for the equity market

Field.Name: Display Quantity
Field.Description: Desired displayed quantity (zero for unchanged)

Field.Name: Client Category
Field.Description: Type of client. Not used by the derivatives market

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Message.Name: Cancel Order
Message.Description: Cancels an existing order entered via OUCH. Partial cancels are not supported; use Replace Order to modify an existing order. The response to a successful Cancel Order is an Order Canceled message. Failed Cancel Order messages are rejected with the Order Rejected message.

Field.Name: Order Token
Field.Description: Should be the Order Token from the original Enter Order, not from any intermediate replaces

Message.Name: Cancel by Order Id
Message.Description: Cancels any order in the book, regardless of which session it was inserted over, using the system-generated Order ID. The response to a successful Cancel by Order Id is an Order Canceled message. Failed requests are rejected with the Order Rejected message.

Field.Name: Order Book Id
Field.Description: Order book identifier

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Order side

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: The identifier assigned to the order by the system

Message.Name: Mass Quote
Message.Description: Used by market makers to send two-sided quotes into a market. Allows submission of multiple quotes (currently restricted to 5) in a single message. Quotes for different securities must belong to the same partition. One quote (two-sided) per participant per instrument is allowed. Quotes can be replaced or cancelled by sending a new Mass Quote for the same instrument(s).

Field.Name: Order Token
Field.Description: Client-generated quote identifier, unique for each request (new, update, cancellation)

Field.Name: Client Category
Field.Description: Type of client

Field.Name: Client Account
Field.Description: Agency/Fund Code. PYM (market maker client) or PYP (market maker portfolio)

Field.Name: Exchange Info
Field.Description: Client account number

Field.Name: No Quote Entries
Field.Description: Number of double-sided quotes in the following QuoteSet repeating group. Currently restricted to a maximum of 5

Field.Name: Quote Set
Field.Description: Repeating group of QuoteSet entries, each representing an individual two-sided quote. Repeats No Quote Entries times

Message.Name: Order Accepted
Message.Description: Acknowledges the receipt and acceptance of a valid Enter Order message. The data fields from the Enter Order message are echoed back, though accepted values may differ from entered values for some fields. Accepted messages are guaranteed to come before any Executed or Canceled messages for an order.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: UNIX time (number of nanoseconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC)

Field.Name: Order Token
Field.Description: Client-generated order identifier

Field.Name: Order Book Id
Field.Description: Order book identifier

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Order side

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: The identifier assigned to the new order by the system. Only unique per Order book and side

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Quantity currently open in the order book

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Signed integer price. Number of decimals is given by the Order book Directory message in ITCH

Field.Name: Time In Force
Field.Description: Time in force

Field.Name: Open Close
Field.Description: Position update for the account

Field.Name: Client Account
Field.Description: Pass-thru field. Account Info should use this field for the derivatives market

Field.Name: Order State
Field.Description: Order state

Field.Name: Customer Info
Field.Description: Pass-thru field

Field.Name: Exchange Info
Field.Description: Only the first 16 bytes are used. Account Info should use this field for the equity market

Field.Name: Pre Trade Quantity
Field.Description: Pre-trade quantity

Field.Name: Display Quantity
Field.Description: Display quantity if reserved order, otherwise set to zero (0)

Field.Name: Client Category
Field.Description: Type of client. Not used by the derivatives market

Field.Name: Off Hours
Field.Description: Off-hours indicator. Used by the derivatives market. Other values are subject to reject the request

Field.Name: SMP Level
Field.Description: Indicates the scope of self-match prevention

Field.Name: SMP Method
Field.Description: Indicates the action that should be undertaken by the trading system in case of a potential self-match

Field.Name: SMP Id
Field.Description: Defines that the order is eligible for self-match prevention

Message.Name: Order Rejected
Message.Description: Used to reject Enter Order messages, Cancel Order messages, and Replace Order messages.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: UNIX time (number of nanoseconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC)

Field.Name: Order Token
Field.Description: Populated from the incoming order; invalid values are preserved

Field.Name: Reject Code
Field.Description: Backend error code. See System Error Messages Reference for more information

Message.Name: Order Replaced
Message.Description: Acknowledges the receipt and acceptance of a valid Replace Order message. The data fields from the Replace Order message are echoed back, though accepted values may differ from entered values for some fields. Uses the Order State field to denote that a replace was accepted and then automatically canceled when the Order State is Not on book.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: UNIX time (number of nanoseconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC)

Field.Name: Replacement Order Token
Field.Description: Client-generated replacement order identifier. Blanked out (with spaces) if the order was modified by the system

Field.Name: Previous Order Token
Field.Description: Order token of the order that was replaced

Field.Name: Order Book Id
Field.Description: Order book identifier

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Order side

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: The identifier assigned to the new order by the system. Only unique per Order book and side

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Quantity currently open in the order book

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Signed integer order price. Number of decimals is given by the Order book Directory message in ITCH

Field.Name: Time In Force
Field.Description: Time in force

Field.Name: Replace Open Close
Field.Description: Position update for the account

Field.Name: Client Account
Field.Description: Pass-thru field. Account Info should use this field for the derivatives market

Field.Name: Order State
Field.Description: Order state. When Order State is 99, the OUCH client that entered the order has lost ownership; no further updates will be received and the only action possible is Cancel by Order Id

Field.Name: Customer Info
Field.Description: Pass-thru field

Field.Name: Exchange Info
Field.Description: Only the first 16 bytes are used. Account Info should use this field for the equity market

Field.Name: Pre Trade Quantity
Field.Description: Pre-trade quantity

Field.Name: Display Quantity
Field.Description: The displayed quantity in case the order is a reserve order, or zero if the order is not a reserve order

Field.Name: Client Category
Field.Description: Type of client. Not used by the derivatives market

Message.Name: Order Canceled
Message.Description: Informs that an order has been canceled. This could be acknowledging a Cancel Order message, or the result of system cancellation. Order Canceled messages are sent when orders are suspended due to connection loss; more than one Order Canceled message may be received for the same order.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: UNIX time (number of nanoseconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC)

Field.Name: Order Token
Field.Description: Client-generated order identifier of the canceled order

Field.Name: Order Book Id
Field.Description: Order book identifier

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Order side

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: The identifier assigned to the canceled order by the system. Only unique per Order book and side

Field.Name: Reason
Field.Description: System change reason code for the cancellation

Message.Name: Order Executed
Message.Description: Returned when a partial or full fill occurs. In case of a combination order fill, one Order Executed message will be received per leg.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: UNIX time (number of nanoseconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC)

Field.Name: Order Token
Field.Description: Client-generated order identifier

Field.Name: Order Book Id
Field.Description: Order book identifier. Needed for combination fills (Order Executed sent per leg)

Field.Name: Traded Quantity
Field.Description: Quantity executed in this trade

Field.Name: Trade Price
Field.Description: Signed integer trade price. Number of decimals is given by the Order book Directory message in ITCH

Field.Name: Match Id
Field.Description: Backend-generated identifier, unique per trade message

Field.Name: Client Category
Field.Description: Type of client. Not used by the derivatives market

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Message.Name: Mass Quote Acknowledgement
Message.Description: A positive response to a Mass Quote message. Every quote in a mass quote message must be responded to with an individual message (Mass Quote Acknowledgement or Mass Quote Rejection). If the individual quote in mass quote is accepted, the system sends two Mass Quote Acknowledgement messages, for bid and offer side.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: UNIX time (number of nanoseconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC)

Field.Name: Order Token
Field.Description: Client-generated quote identifier

Field.Name: Order Book Id
Field.Description: Order book identifier

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Leaves quantity

Field.Name: Traded Quantity
Field.Description: Traded quantity

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price in Mass Quote message, except when the quote status is Traded, in which case this is the traded price

Field.Name: Quote Side
Field.Description: Side of the acknowledged quote

Field.Name: Quote Status
Field.Description: Identifies the status of the mass quote acknowledgement

Message.Name: Mass Quote Rejection
Message.Description: A negative response to a Mass Quote message. If an individual quote in the mass quote is rejected, a single Mass Quote Rejection is sent for that quote with the Order Book Id populated. If all quotes in the mass quote message are rejected, only one Mass Quote Rejection is sent for the whole request, without an Order Book Id.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: UNIX time (number of nanoseconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC)

Field.Name: Order Token
Field.Description: Client-generated quote identifier

Field.Name: Order Book Id
Field.Description: Order book identifier

Field.Name: Reject Code
Field.Description: Identifies the rejection reason of the mass quote. See error code catalog for details

Group.Name: Quote Set
Group.Description: One double-sided quote entry in a repeating Mass Quote QuoteSet group. Repeats No Quote Entries times, up to a maximum of 5, within the containing Mass Quote message.

Field.Name: Order Book Id
Field.Description: Order book identifier of this quote

Field.Name: Bid Price
Field.Description: Bid price. Number of decimals and allowed tick steps are given by the Order book Directory message in ITCH

Field.Name: Offer Price
Field.Description: Offer price. Number of decimals and allowed tick steps are given by the Order book Directory message in ITCH

Field.Name: Bid Size
Field.Description: Bid quantity

Field.Name: Offer Size
Field.Description: Offer quantity
